user_story: As a user, I want to be able to add, edit, and delete records in the web table so that I can manage my data effectively. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can click the 'Add' button (id: 'addNewRecordButton') to open the form for adding a new record. 2. The user can submit the form with valid data and see the new record appear in the table. 3. The user can edit an existing record by clicking on it and modifying the details. 4. The user can delete a record and see it removed from the table. 5. The search functionality works with the input field (id: 'searchBox') to filter records based on the input text.
